Data Availability Statement: Our data is part of an
ongoing longitudinal study and contains potentially
sensitive information. The consent of the
participants of the Behavior Outlook Norwegian
Developmental Study (BONDS), as approved by
the Regional Committee for Medical and Health
Research Ethics in South-East Norway, does not
include sharing a de-identified data set on an open
server. However, upon request the dataset may be
made accessible in our secure data server to
researchers who meet the criteria for access to
confidential data, under a data processing
agreement. Requests should be addressed to the
Norwegian Center for Child Behavioral
Development (NUBU), Oslo, Norway (mail:
post@nubu.no) or to the project leader Ane Naerde
(ane.narde@nubu.no).
Funding: AN received a grant from The Research
Council of Norway (Grant 283438/H20). https://
www.forskningsradet.no/en/. The funders had no
role in study design, data collection or analysis,
decisions to publish, or preparation of the
manuscript.

that no competing interests exist.
